definitions.explanation: A small round French confection made of two almond-meringue shells sandwiching a cream or jam filling. Sold in bright pastel colors and treated in Japan as a stylish gift sweet.

examples.japanese: マカロン⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{三|みっ}つ→三つ：02970_mittsu⟧⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧。
⟦{色|いろ}とりどり→色とりどり：10404_irotoridori⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧マカロン⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{箱|はこ}→箱：02162_hako⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{並|なら}んでいる→並ぶ：00605_narabu⟧。
examples.english: Colorful macarons are lined up in the box.

examples.japanese: ⟦{手土産|てみやげ}→手土産：08353_temiyage⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧マカロン⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}って→持つ：00478_motsu⟧いったら、{子|こ}どもたち⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦とても→とても：00593_totemo⟧⟦{喜|よろこ}んだ→喜ぶ：01169_yorokobu⟧。
examples.english: When I took macarons as a gift, the children were delighted.

notes:
Counted with 〜⟦{個|こ}→〜個：00645_ko⟧. Popular as a small gift or souvenir because the colors photograph well and the boxes are attractive.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- マカロン⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{食|た}べる→食べる：00396_taberu⟧: to eat a macaron
- ⟦{色|いろ}とりどり→色とりどり：10404_irotoridori⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧マカロン: colorful macarons
- マカロン⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{詰|つ}め{合|あ}わせ→詰め合わせ：14175_tsumeawase⟧: an assortment of macarons
- マカロン⟦カラー→カラー：10820_karaa⟧: pastel "macaron colors"

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦マカロニ→マカロニ：30384_makaroni⟧: macaroni — a completely different word despite the similar sound
- ⟦メレンゲ→メレンゲ：29702_merenge⟧: meringue — the whipped egg white the shells are made from
- ⟦{焼|や}き{菓子|がし}→焼き菓子：15806_yakigashi⟧: baked sweets — the shop category macarons are usually sold under
